name: Legate Corvinus
notes: AC 15 (studded leather). Commander of Vindolanda. Military authority damaged after Varro's treason and Lucius's death. Commands the party as a deniable auxiliary strike unit.
gm_notes: Post-Session 3 state: Centurion Varro is dead (killed by Ursula after opening the gate); Tribune Lucius is dead (killed in S3 forest spider ambush). Corvinus is politically cornered. Deep secret: secretly wants the Spear of Mars destroyed so its madness never reaches Rome, but is financially owned by Senator Brutus. Relies on the party to destroy or neutralize the spear under fog of war.
objective: Survive the political fallout of Varro's treason and Lucius's death while securing the frontier.
goal: Direct the party as an independent, deniable unit to eliminate the blood cult and resolve the Spear of Mars.
agenda: Keep imperial scrutiny at bay and manage debts to Brutus while ensuring the cursed weapon is extinguished.
secret: Secretly wants the Spear of Mars destroyed. Watched Varro rot from its shadow and dreads what it would do to Rome.
